description: agent-hierarchy — SessionStart injects the resolved role→model table and the orchestration protocol on startup, resume, clear, fork, and post-compaction (so it survives compaction). It classifies the session four ways: inside a durable-agent pane it injects the pane protocol instead; a subagent (agent_id set) gets nothing, which is the intent here, since role agents carry their own instructions in agents/*.md and an Implementor that starts orchestrating would defeat the hierarchy; a top-level `claude --agent <hierarchy role>` session gets a short notice that it is NOT the Orchestrator; everything else gets the ordinary directive — plus, when the durable-agent registry holds live keys, a roster of them (verify-and-reap on the way, so a booting Orchestrator never sees ghosts). The discriminator is agent_id, not agent_type — a top-level --agent session sets agent_type too, so testing it misclassifies a genuine main session as a subagent. Silent when the config sets enabled:false; with no config at all it emits a one-line nudge to run /hierarchy init. PreToolUse runs two hooks on Agent/Task. The ultra gate holds Ultra-Advisor escalation for the user: the first dispatch of each session is denied with instructions to put the decision to the user and record their answer (allow this session / ask each time / blocked this session) via hooks/gate.mjs; the answer is session-scoped and lives in ~/.claude/agent-hierarchy.gate.json. The durable offer denies a dispatch ONCE when its subagent_type matches a live, idle durable agent, with instructions to put the durable-vs-subagent choice to the user; the identical re-run passes, with offers recorded per session+type in ~/.claude/agent-hierarchy.durable-offers.jsonl so it can never ping-pong. Every other tool call passes through untouched. SubagentStop runs the usage collector: it sums the finished subagent's transcript (token counts the harness already logged) into ~/.claude/agent-hierarchy.usage.jsonl — plain node, zero model cost — which /hierarchy usage or hooks/usage-report.mjs renders as session/day/week/month reports. Stop runs the durable-agent reply relay, which is INERT unless AGENT_HIERARCHY_PANE_DIR is set: outside a pane it is one environment lookup and an exit, with no stdin read and no imports. Inside a pane it turns the session's final assistant message into a reply file, but only when the Orchestrator left a pending token — which is what makes a durable agent unable to initiate contact.
